items.title: A closed subspace of a w-local spectral space is w-local
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file proetale.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that a closed subspace of a w-local spectral space is again w-local (statement lines 419-423). The proof (proof lines 425-431) identifies the closed points of the subspace as the trace of the closed points of the ambient space and shows that the unique specialization of any point lands inside the subspace. H2: two verifications, written out in full.
